due_when.clears_when: run_system_backtest resolves non-zero venue cost by default, with a test that a direct call records slippage>0 for a perp symbol

origin.rerun: grep -n 'SLIPPAGE_BPS_ROUNDTRIP\|execution_costs' scripts/research/build_backtest_panel.py scripts/prop/evaluate_prop.py; grep -rn 'run_system_backtest(' --include=*.py scripts src

what: backtest_system.run_system_backtest reads module globals SLIPPAGE_BPS_ROUNDTRIP / FUNDING_BPS_PER_WINDOW that default to 0.0 and are set only inside backtest_system.main(). Direct callers that never set them run FEE-ONLY: scripts/research/build_backtest_panel.py:276 (panel P&L used downstream) and scripts/prop/evaluate_prop.py:~178 (prop-firm pass/fail evaluator). grep of both files for SLIPPAGE/execution_costs returned nothing. Fix: make run_system_backtest resolve the venue-aware cost policy itself when the globals are unset (or take explicit cost params), then re-state any panel/prop figure produced before. scripts/research/same_symbol_head_to_head.py already sets them (apply_cost_policy). Prop figures are the money-relevant ones: a fee-only prop evaluation overstates survival.
